title: Comfort Club Member Relief on Home Comfort Financing Late Fees
content:
**Member benefit schedule — Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements holders who finance with Home Comfort Financing.**

A borrower who holds a Comfort Club agreement receives a late-fee member relief on Home Comfort Financing late fees. The late-fee member relief is 20 percent when the borrower's Comfort Club agreement is active and has run at least 5 consecutive terms, 10 percent when that agreement is active and has run fewer than 5 consecutive terms, and zero when the borrower holds no active Comfort Club agreement.

The tier is read from the borrower's Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements record: the agreement's status and its count of consecutive terms.

| Comfort Club agreement status | Consecutive terms run | Late-fee member relief |
|---|---|---|
| active | 5 or more | 20 percent |
| active | fewer than 5 | 10 percent |
| no active agreement (none held, or the agreement is in any status other than active) | any | zero |

**How the relief enters the late fee.** The late-fee member relief is one of the late-fee reliefs that make up the late-fee relief percentage. The late-fee reliefs are added together and the scheduled late fee is reduced once by that total; the reliefs never act one after another.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical members)

- Active agreement, 5 consecutive terms: 20 percent (5 is at least 5).
- Active agreement, 4 consecutive terms: 10 percent.
- Agreement lapsed after 7 consecutive terms: zero — the agreement is not active.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A scheduled late fee of $32.00 and a late-fee relief percentage of 20 percent with no other late-fee relief: $32.00 multiplied by 80 and divided by 100 is $25.60.
